description: Phase 6 (MODELING-READONLY-VIEWER): a read-only presentation surface for a semantic modeling model - no model tree, no inspector, no editor chrome and no writer. It projects the model with the shared ModelingDiagramGenerator and renders the presentation copy through TmDiagramEditor in viewer mode; the diff and heatmap overlays restyle only that copy (public DiagramStyle / DiagramNode.Data), never the caller's model. The keyboard/text alternative is a real list of buttons in topological order; every overlay carries a text equivalent (legend counts, scale bands and values, one polite live region) and ExportSvgAsync renders a standalone SVG through IDiagramSvgRenderer with the overlay tokens resolved for the requested theme.

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description: The semantic model to present. Required.

parameters.name: ViewId
parameters.description: Optional view id to project; null uses the default view / generated grid.

parameters.name: FitMode
parameters.description: How the diagram fits into the viewer box (Width or Page).

parameters.name: Zoom
parameters.description: Explicit zoom (1 = 100 %). Null fits the diagram through FitMode; an explicit value wins over fit-on-load.

parameters.name: ShowZoomControls
parameters.description: Whether the embedded viewer renders its zoom controls (the viewer-mode toolbar's zoom group and the mobile zoom pill).

parameters.name: HighlightElementIds
parameters.description: Element and relationship ids to emphasize without selecting them.

parameters.name: SelectedElementId
parameters.description: Two-way selected element or relationship id.

parameters.name: OnElementClick
parameters.description: Raised when the reader activates an element or relationship on the canvas or in the element list.

parameters.name: DiffOverlay
parameters.description: Optional diff overlay (added / removed / changed / layout-only).

parameters.name: Heatmap
parameters.description: Optional heatmap overlay (normalized 0..1 value per element or relationship id).

parameters.name: ShowLegend
parameters.description: Whether the notation legend card renders (reuses the shared ModelingNotationCatalog).

parameters.name: ShowElementList
parameters.description: Whether the keyboard/text alternative element list renders.

parameters.name: ElementListContent
parameters.description: Host slot replacing the default row content of the element list; the list semantics stay.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: CSS height of the viewer root.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: How the viewer resolves its presentation; Auto measures its own container.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the viewer root.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: Accessible name of the viewer region; null uses the localized default.

parameters.name: ShowElementListInPrint
parameters.description: Print opt-in: keep the element list in the printed output. Default false - print shows the diagram and its legends only.
